directoryUrl.description: FSC Directory base URL (no trailing slash) — ASSUMED shape, see design.md "Directory API shape".

mode.description: `token` (default) sends a Bearer Authorization header from `encryptedToken`. `mtls` dispatches over a real mutual-TLS connection using `mtls.*` — closes the real Outway/Inway transport gap.

encryptedToken.description: Required when `mode=token` (the default). The FSC-fronting API token, encrypted at rest via OCP\Security\ICrypto — never store the raw token.

scheme.description: Authorization header scheme, used only when `mode=token`.

mtls.description: Required when `mode=mtls`. Client certificate material, each field individually encrypted at rest via OCP\Security\ICrypto.

encryptedCaBundle.description: Optional PEM CA bundle to verify the peer against.
